name: Romans with N. T. Wright
description: One short section of Romans a day, in the 65 sections N. T. Wright uses in Romans for Everyone (Part 1, chapters 1 to 8, then Part 2, chapters 9 to 16). Read the passage, then Wright's section in the book (the Shelf lists it beside each passage).
